title: Microsoft Flint chart IL: compact specs compile to Vega, ECharts, Plotly
summary: Microsoft Flint is a visualization intermediate language where agents write compact chart specs that compile to Vega-Lite, ECharts, Chart.js, Plotly, or Excel with publication themes. Hosted flint-chart-mcp exposes the compiler to coding agents.
question_it_answers: How can an agent emit one chart spec that compiles to multiple visualization backends with styled themes?

claims.text: Flint derives scales, axes, and spacing from a semantic spec plus data and optional theme.
claims.evidence: Flint derives scales, axes, spacing from semantic spec + data + optional theme.
claims.subject: infographics-diagrams

claims.text: A hosted MCP server at flint.data-formulator.ai/mcp exposes Flint to agent clients.
claims.subject: mcp-and-agent-browsers

claims.text: flint-chart 0.5.1 assembleVegaLite and assembleECharts both accept the getting-started Line Chart spec; hosted flint-chart-mcp v0.5.1 lists six tools and render_chart backends are vegalite, echarts, and chartjs only.
